titles.romaji: Meitantei Conan: Conan vs. Kid - Shikkoku no Sniper
titles.native: 名探偵コナン コナンvsキッド 漆黒の狙撃者(スナイパー)

description:
3D IMAX movie, shown only at the Suntory Museum in Osaka.

The story involves a heist taking place on 15 Aug at the Takaramachi Jewelry Museum where a jewel worth 1 Billion Yen is stolen.
